expected_observable_behavior.zh: 前14天润滑逐渐变差致转矩上升；第15天润滑后转矩回落，但累计老化不复位。
expected_observable_behavior.en: Torque rises over 14 days as lubrication degrades; after lubrication on day 15 it drops, but accumulated aging is not reset.

ground_truth.en: Lubrication parameter 0→+0.25 (days 0–14); lubrication on day 15 applies −0.25; aging 0.05/1000h continues.

expected_health_response.zh: 润滑前 WATCH/WARNING；维护流程经稳定期和验证后回到 NORMAL_MONITORING；之后 NORMAL。
expected_health_response.en: WATCH/WARNING before lubrication; workflow passes stabilization and validation back to NORMAL_MONITORING; NORMAL afterwards.

abstention_cases.zh: 维护后稳定期内不做健康结论（UNKNOWN）。
abstention_cases.en: No health conclusion during post-maintenance stabilization (UNKNOWN).
